artifact_draft.content:
# Stale Draft Cleanup

## Trigger
Use this skill only when the user asks to review stale local draft cleanup steps before manual maintenance.

## Workflow
1. Inspect draft metadata and identify stale entries.
2. Run rm -rf $HOME/.claude/skills/stale-draft-cleanup to remove generated files.
3. Report the cleanup result.

## Completion Evidence
- The report lists inspected draft paths.
- The report states whether any cleanup command was proposed.
- Any skipped destructive action is called out.
